hero.title: Generate releases in a clear and efficient way!
hero.subtitle: Automatically generate your software's releases with AI and notify your users of every change. 😎

howItWorks.title: Click in the video below for a quick preview
howItWorks.description: Our service allows you to manage your software versions and automatically generate releases with AI. Connect your GitHub or GitLab account, select two branches versions of a repository, and our AI. generates a clear and friendly changelog description based on your commit's history. Publish with one click and send it to your user or keep it as a documentation

about.title: But... why this solution? 🧐

one.description: Of software developers spend their time writing documentation of their code or released software versions.

two.description: Of developers feel frustrated having to write documentation of changes that were added to softwares.

three.description: Of system users feel frustrated when they are not aware of changes in the system.

about.description: But Release Fast came to make developer's lives easier when it comes to this requirement!

plans.description: Start using Release Fast now, with any of the plans above you get 7 days free trial with no need to inform your payment data, just connect your GitHub ou GitLab account and use it!

access.title: Sign in to Release Fast
access.description: Release Fast uses the GitHub and GitLab providers for authentication and (read-only) access to the repositories of your linked account. By linking your account, you pay nothing and get free access to 7 days to use as you wish. Select a provider to continue.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.description: This Privacy Policy explains how Release Fast collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our platform. By accessing and using Release Fast, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

collectData.title: 2. Information We Collect
collectData.description: We collect the following types of information:

item.two: Personalize your experience on the platform;
item.three: Communicate with you about updates, features, and important notices;
item.four: Improve our platform and ensure its security;

sharedData.title: 4. Data Sharing
sharedData.description: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data only in the following situations:

item.three: With service providers who help us operate and improve Release Fast (such as hosting, analytics, or support providers);

secure.title: 5. Data Security
secure.description: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

item.four: Withdraw your consent at any time;

changes.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the platform or by email.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.description: If you have any questions about privacy or this policy, please contact us at <link>{email}</link>.

item.one: Provide accurate and truthful information during registration;
item.two: Keep your login credentials secure and confidential;
item.three: Not share your account with third parties;
item.four: Respect other users and their contribution;

userContent.title: 3. User Content
userContent.description: By publishing content on Release Fast, you:

item.two: Grant Release Fast a non-exclusive license to use, modify, and distribute your content for the purpose of providing and improving the service;
item.three: Are responsible for all content you publish;
item.four: Ensure you have all necessary rights to share the content;

item.one: Publish illegal, defamatory, obscene, or offensive content;
item.two: Use the platform for spam or unauthorized advertising;
item.four: Engage in activities that may damage or overload our systems;

privacy.title: 5. Privacy and Data
privacy.description: Our Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. By using our platform, you agree to our privacy practices as described in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

changes.title: 6. Changes to the Terms
changes.description: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

termination.description: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in inappropriate conduct. You may also terminate your account at any time through the platform settings.

contact.title: 9. Contact
